page.layout: One printed page, single column of text with paired lines (Latin/Greek-letter forms on the left, Latin translation on the right). Running head at top with page number at top right. No margin notes.

main_text.head: Præt. imperfect.
Præt. perfect.
main_text.l: Io Vdì,Vdíi,& ho vdito Ego audiui.
tu Vdisti,& hai vdito tu audiuisti.
colúi Vdi,& ha vdito ille audiuit.
Nói Vdimmo,& habbiámo vdito Nos audiuimus.
vói Vdiste,& hauéte vdito vos audiuistis.
coloro Vdirono,Vdiron,Vdiro,Vdir,& hánno vdito illi audiuerunt.
main_text.head: Præt. plusquamperfect.
Futurum.

page.notes: Several Latin forms are printed with partly obscured or doubtful letters (e.g. "Vdiráì", "Vdiuano"); the reading is approximate. The paired lines are set in parallel columns, transcribed line by line as lists.
